text:
Nora Li: AegisCore reached out about a joint energy vs throughput characterization across their latest board. Theywant numbers for steady-state tokens/sec/W across short/med/long contexts and an exploration of kernel patches that reduce DRAM stalls. Proposed schedule: two-day remote collect (Wed/Thu), followed by an analysis day. Can we get a quick owners list?

Ethan Rivera: I can take kernel toggles and build artifacts. Plan: baseline kernel + two experimental builds: `aegiscore/prefetch_off` and `aegiscore/latency_opt`. Key knobs: disable hardware prefetch, tweak L1/L2 stride limits, and experiment with cacheline size hinting. I'll publish images to `ghcr.io/redwood/aegis-bench:ae-v1` and `ae-v2`. Patch notes will include git SHA and `uname -r`.

Priya Desai: I'll own testbed orchestration and partner coordination. Testbeds: `aegis-int-01` (Redwood lab) and `aegis-ext-03` (partner rack). Artifact bucket: `s3://redwood-partners/aegiscore/energy-throughput-2026/`. CSV ingestion schema we should standardize on (downstream wants energy integrated):
```
run_id,model,seq_len,batch,tokens_total,elapsed_s,energy_j,J_avg_W,tokens_per_w,tokens_per_joule,p50_ms,p95_ms,kernel_sha,container_sha,notes
```
Please ensure `energy_j` is the time-integrated joules over the run (not instantaneous).

Nora Li: Add meta tags to each run: `partner=aegiscore`, `campaign=energy-throughput-alpha`, `owner=priya`. Also require a 200-prompt QA check with our public prompt set and partner private prompts (mark as `private=true` in notes).

Ethan Rivera: Sample run command for partners:
```
./aegis_bench --model=gpt-base --seq=1024 --batch=8 --duration=240 --power-sample=1s --out=s3://redwood-partners/aegiscore/energy-throughput-2026/$RUN_ID/
```
Make sure partners capture `power_raw.csv` (timestamp,power_w), `tokens.log`, `dmesg.log`, and `thermal.csv` (timestamp,temp_c). We'll compute `energy_j` by summing `power_w * sample_interval`.

OpsBot: Reminder: for remote runs ensure SSH bastion key is uploaded to `vault/partners/aegiscore/keys` and `ansible` inventory includes `aegis-ext-03`. We'll bind-mount `/sys/class/powercap` into the container and grant `SYS_ADMIN` where partner policy allows.

Priya Desai: I'll add a short checklist in the Jira PRJ-3311: steps for partner lab onboarding, PMU hookup, heater stabilization period (10 mins), and a recommended warmup run (2 minutes) before measurements. Also adding a CSV validator to our CI to check headers and sample rates.

Ethan Rivera: Acceptance heuristics proposal: prefer configs with tokens_per_joule improvement >=6% and p95 latency change <=12%. If tokens_per_joule improves but p95 grows >12%, flag for manual SRE review. Watch out for increased page faults or swap activity in `vmstat`.

Bench-Bot: Bench harness `validate-run` will run after upload and post results to `#eng-runtime` summary. Dashboard will be created under `dashboards/partners/aegiscore-energy`.

Nora Li: Good catch re swap. Also ask partner to capture perf counters for last-level-cache misses if possible. Priya, please confirm partner can expose PMBus or INA sensors; if not, fall back to wall-meter reading with a 1% calibration note.

Priya Desai: Confirmed with AegisCore: they can provide INA sensors and a wall-meter. I'll record which sensor used in `notes`. Scheduling the remote collection for Wed/Thu next week 08:00-16:00 PT. I'll post the runbook link in the Jira once committed.

Nora Li: Thanks everyone. Ethan -- once images are pushed, ping here and I'll loop in AegisCore engineering. Final deliverables: raw CSVs, computed summary table, 2-slide marketplace blurb (one sentence + one chart), and a short changelog for our docs site.
